ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity field (base pixel values ~20-50). High-intensity white mottling (pixel values ~190-240) concentrated along the inferior (leading) edge boundary, primarily in the central and right-central regions. Numerous small, isolated high-contrast circular point-features scattered throughout both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse U-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 138 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire superior boundary. Amplitudes range from 2 to 10 pixels in the medial sections, increasing to macro-serrations (15-25 pixels) at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of ~12 circular ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters; notable cluster of 6 in the mid-left lobe and 4 in the mid-right lobe, varying in diameter from 5 to 15 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel diagonal high-intensity linear features (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) located on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular material loss at both distal tips; the far-left tip exhibits a highly fragmented, jagged geometry suggesting significant historical tissue loss.
